name: v3.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
 - Iterative tasks are now available as an experimental feature (#4210)
 - Terminal width and the `rc.defaultwidth` are now handled better in task burndown (#4225, #4226, #4227, #4230)
 - Annotations widths are handled correctly in reports (#4233)
 - The task projects output now correctly nests projects (#4232)
 - The OR operator is now rejected in contexts, as it behaves differently for read and write (#4229)
 - Setting LIBSQLITE3_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG when building will link to the system SQLite library (#4223)
 - Dashes are now allowed in rc.* DOM references (#4197)
 - Wrapped annotation lines in task list reports now retain their indentation (#4189)
 - S3-compatible storage backends can be used with the new rc.sync.aws.endpoint_url config (#4176)

## New Contributors
* @freswa made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4176
* @gregbell made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4189
* @swardman made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4190
* @brzzdev made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4200
* @RayanR000 made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4197
* @jatinninety9 made their first contribution in https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/pull/4225

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/compare/v3.5.0...v3.6.0
